Commentary.Commentary: KL Rahul says he felt like a spectator watching Rohit Sharma bat. Adds it was a wonderful performance from him and the wicket was good for batting as well. Feels the first six he hit was very satisfying amongst the rest. States the first couple of overs he and Rohit wanted to give themselves time, the wicket was a bit sticky but after scoring a few boundaries they felt comfortable. Mentions they assessed the conditions in the first six overs, took their time and then went for it. Let's everybody know that in the 11th over Sharma played a couple of dot balls, so he told him there was a double hundred for the taking but he just smiled and said he doesn't care about that. Goes on to say they have top class bowlers in their ranks and also adds that they must have analyzed that wicket well and will perform when they come out to bowl.

The ground has small boundaries, but you'd argue that Sri Lanka should have done better than they did. Conceding 260 anywhere isn't acceptable. On top of that, dropping both openers when they're in such fine form cost them dearly. A couple of wickets from the skipper Perera and Pradeep, but they came when it was a little too late. A blazing start is what they need and the openers hold the key for them. Join us back in a short time.

A power-packed batting display from the hosts after being put into bat. The two openers set it all up for them. First it was the Rohit Sharma show where the skipper went ballistic and scored a brisk ton, then Rahul followed suit with a fluent 89 and those big knocks were backed with some lusty blows by Dhoni and Pandya towards the death. There is a mammoth total on the board and they will be thoroughly satisfied with it.

Good final delivery to end the innings. This has been a good over from the Sri Lankan captain. Yorker on off, Karthik digs it out in front of cover-point and takes a single. INDIA FINISH ON 260/5! It's the joint-second highest total in T20I cricket.
FOUR! Length ball on the pads, slower in pace, Karthik flicks it away through backward square leg for a boundary. The fielder in the deep hares to his right but can't reach it.
Dinesh Karthik to bat next.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Thisara is right on the money with that. Full on off, Dhoni in an attempt to slam it out of the park swings across the line but misses. The off stick is knocked over and that's the end of Dhoni's breezy cameo.
Pandey drives this fuller delivery through mid on and gets off strike.
Manish Pandey is the next batsman in.

OUT! He's gone! Iyer knew that, so the review was probably for namesake. Fuller and slower on the stumps, Iyer misses the shot and is caught flush on the pads. Appeal from Thisara, the umpire raises his finger. It's taken upstairs and replays show that Shreyas is gone. He started walking even before the decision came in, the third umpire actually had to ask the on-field umpire to stop him. Anyway, Iyer is gone and the Lankan captain has this wicket.
Lbw review against Shreyas Iyer is gone upstairs. He looks plumb in real time.
On middle and leg, around the hips, Dhoni gets it off the inside edge on the leg side for one.
Shreyas Iyer in next to bat.

OUT! No hat-trick for Sadeera! He manages to hold on to his catch on his third attempt in the match. Back of a length around off, Pandya just throws his bat at this. Gets a big top edge towards covers where Sadeera backpedals and takes a good reverse cup catch. One over remains, India need 11. The highest T20I total under threat? Surely!

SIX! That's an insane shot! Superbly done by Hardik Pandya! Full and wide outside off, Pandya carves it over backward point and to the crowd in the stands. They're having some catching practice, more than the visiting team.
FOUR! That's gone as fast as it's come! Overpitched on off, Pandya drills it back down the ground for a boundary. This is now India's highest T20I score. There's surely more to come.
Hardik Pandya walks into the middle next.

OUT! A rare positive instance in this innings for Sri Lanka. That's a brilliant take from Niroshan Dickwella. Full and wide outside off, Rahul looks to go big down the ground but edges it behind. It's travelling fast, but Dickwella dives superman-like to his right and takes a one-handed stunner. Lovely take, something for the Lankans to smile about. Rahul misses out on a century. Would have been the first instance of two batsmen scoring centuries in the same T20I innings.

SIX! What a hit! Low full toss on the pads, Rahul flicks it over square leg. Gunaratne out in the deep has a chance to catch it, but he maybe loses it somewhere in the lights. Goes over his head and over the boundary.
Quite full from Pradeep, outside off, driven through covers by Dhoni for a run.
SIX! Full and outside off, just an extension of the arms. In essence a lofted cover drive, really. Rahul clears the rope and gets another biggie to his name.
Another slow one, shorter in length, Rahul is early into the shot again, a pull this time, and misses.
Takes the pace off this and bowls this outside off, KL is too early into the shot as he misses to connect.

SIX! Chameera bowls it with some real pace, but Rahul hits it with double power straight back. Really full on middle, Rahul goes deep inside his crease and hammers it straight back down the ground. The ball has disappeared deep into the stands, no idea where. But it's gone high somewhere.
Back of a length outside off, KL gets a bottom edge behind to the keeper as he looks to connect.
Full ball, on middle stumps, drilled to long on. Single taken.
Dushmantha Chameera back to bowl.

SIX! Maximum to end the over! Too full from Dananjaya, Rahul leans ahead a bit and lifts it so comfortably over long on for a biggie. Surprising the ball hasn't been lost once with it being smacked around everywhere.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SIX! Dhoni has found his groove! Tossed up on middle and leg, Dhoni kneels down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a biggie. The fielder in the deep is only a spectator.
Wide! Darted well outside off, goes across the tramline as Dhoni leaves it alone.
Flatter and shorter on the stumps, MS mistimes the back foot punch back to the bowler.
Wide! Well outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Fuller length ball outside off, pushed into the covers.
SIX! That's MS Dhoni for you, makes everything look so easy. Full and in the slot, he smokes it over long off and in the 2nd tier.
Akila Dananjaya is back.
Rahul drives this full ball through the covers and picks up a couple of runs to end the over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Wide! Down the leg side, Rahul looks to help it fine down the leg side but misses. The 200 is up for India now.

Not out! Poor review, really. But it's probably done more out of desperation than anything else. Maybe wanted to waste time as well? Possibly. Anyway, coming to the ball. Length delivery angling back in, Dhoni is caught on the pads as he looks to work it away on the leg side. Gets hit on the pads and there's an appeal. The batsmen cross over as the umpire doesn't bother with it. The Lankans review it, in whatever hope, and their hopes are crushed when the replays roll in. They show that the ball is going down leg and height is also an issue.
A review for an lbw against MS Dhoni is taken upstairs by Sri Lanka.
Rahul takes a step out of his crease and works it away on the leg side for a single.
Length ball on middle and leg, goes off the batsman's thigh pad and falls on the leg side as he attempts to swing across the line. Leg bye taken.
Well done, Thisara! Bowls a slower one first up, Dhoni has a wild slog across the line but is too early into the shot. Misses it altogether as it goes under his bat.
Thisara Perera brings himself back on.

FOUR! That's actually not a bad ball but still it's gone for a boundary. Just one of those evenings. Yorker on the stumps tailing back in, Rahul just manes to get some bat on it and it's off the inside edge past the leg stump for a boundary.
SIX! The back-of-the-hand slower one doesn't work, KL Rahul picked that up quite early. Positioned himself well for the hoick and went bang over square leg for half a dozen.
Wide! Pressure showing? Clearly. Spears it full and outside off, across the tramline and the umpire stretches his hands.
Full and wide, driven through to sweeper cover for a single.
Wide! Too far outside off, MS lets it be. It's across the tramline so the umpire signals wide.
Short into the body, helps the pull down to fine leg for one.

FOUR! That's just inside the rope. Consecutive fifties for KL Rahul, his 3rd in this format. Length ball there to be hit, Rahul lofts it over mid-wicket. Looks like it's going to go all the way but the ball falls just inside the rope. Replays confirm that. KL has been in fine touch since coming in the side, has taken full advantage of the chance given to him.

Shout for a leg before which is turned down. Just back of a length on off, Dhoni goes for the big pull but is caught high on the thigh. Leg bye taken as the ball falls on the off side. Sri Lanka are contemplating taking a review, not sure why. That hit him high on the thigh.
Nuwan Pradeep to bowl again.
The groundstaff is out once again. Have the big, thick rope with it to clear the dew off the field. A short halt because of it, the players take this chance to get some fluids in.
Smartly done. Works this towards short mid on and takes off. Dhoni is quick so it doesn't matter even if Akila got to the ball fast himself.
Well outside off, MS has nothing to do with that.
Knocks this full ball down to long on and crosses over.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for MS Dhoni! He swings and swings hard, clears the full ball over wide mid off and sends it across the rope, beating the fielder in the deep.
FOUR! Overpitched from Akila and that's dispatched. On the stumps, Dhoni drills this through mid on and away to the boundary line.
Dhoni is off the mark with a drive towards mid on. Single taken.
Dhoni dances down the track to this fuller ball and hits it back to the bowler.
MS Dhoni walks in at No.3.

OUT! ROHIT SHARMA IS GONE! An imperious knock comes to an end. Short ball outside off, Rohit looks to loft it over short third man but finds Akila Dananjaya there who takes a good catch. The Indian skipper then waits as he thinks it's a no ball for height, but the umpire doesn't signal anything. He has to walk back, but he's done his job, to say the least. The Indore crowd has been thoroughly entertained as Rohit Sharma walks back to a loud cheer. Thoroughly deserved.
SIX! That's outta here! Rohit Sharma, take a bow, my man! Low full toss on the stumps, Sharma just lofts it over mid-wicket and that's another maximum. Played that with so much ease.

FOUR! This is now India's highest opening partnership. Though technically it should be in Rohit Sharma's individual kitty. Full and wide outside off, Sharma flays it through the left of sweeper cover for a boundary.
SIX! Smart decision, eh, Skip? Short of a length in to the body, Sharma muscles the pull and the ball has gone deep into the stands over mid-wicket.
A change of bat for Rohit Sharma. Okay wait, probably not. He's sent that back. Anyway, Dushmantha Chameera into the bowling attack now.
The batsman has just thrown his bat at the ball and finds the gap through mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Three dots in a row. A rare sight this today. Rohit looks to smash it away, but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Use of the feet to get to the pitch but no run comes off it as Sharma can't put it away.
Flat and short outside off, cut away square of the wicket on the off side.
Angelo Mathews has pulled up and is on the ground. The physio is out to have a look at him. Maybe it's his hamstring again. He's off the field so Akila Dananjaya will complete the remaining over.

FOUR! 2nd T20I hundred for Rohit Sharma! Fastest century by an Indian, joint-fastest overall. If there was any Indian who could equal David Miller's record, it was surely going to be him. What a way to bring it up. Fuller length ball outside off, Sharma smacks this on the up and pierces the gap in the covers for a boundary. Sensational knock, he removes his helmet and celebrates in joy. Now for a possible double ton?
Rahul does the sensible thing by pushing this towards sweeper cover and brings Sharma on strike.
Angelo Mathews to bowl.

SIX! Three in a row! That's 26 off the over! He's seeing the ball like a football. Sees the ball full outside off, Rohit sends it sailing high and handsome over the cover fence and picks up another maximum to his name. This is a crazy knock from the Indian skipper, can't believe what's happening here.
SIX! Two in a row! Full and wide, outside off, Sharma just throws his bat wildly at this. Clears the point fence and that's into the stands again.
SIX! BANG! Take that, Thisara! Full on the stumps, right in his arc and Rohit punishes this. Smashes it down the ground, over long on by clearing his front leg and earns another maximum.
Wide! Fired too wide outside off, wide called by the umpire. Pressure showing on the Lankan skipper's face.

DROPPED AND SIX! That's the second blunder from Sadeera in this game, this was a little more difficult than his first attempt. Rohit Sharma slogs this high over mid-wicket. Samarawickrama in the deep runs to his right, a bit behind and leaps. It hits his palms and then lobs over across the rope for a biggie.
Fuller outside off, looks to hit it hard through the off side but misses.
Makes a little room as Thisara serves it on a length on the stumps, placed down to long on for a single by Rahul.
Thisara Perera back on.
FOUR! What was to be a good over is ruined by a boundary on the last delivery. Low full toss on leg, Sharma works it through the left of short fine leg for a boundary.
The ball stops a bit as KL checks his punch. In the air but well wide of the bowler as the ball rolls towards mid off. Short extra cover moves to his right and cuts it off as the batsmen take one.
One more single as Rohit works it easily through mid-wicket.
Touch ahead of a length, close to the off stick, eased through the vacant spaces in the cover region. One run taken.
Waits for the length ball to come to him as he opens the bat-face and guides it to third man.
Rahul sensibly rotates strikes. Rohit Sharma is on song, so he just brings him back on strike with a single through the covers.
Nuwan Pradeep to bowl again.

FOUR! Man, he has decided to let it fly here! His accelerating abilities are on show again. Crossed fifty and then go boom. With the full face of the bat, he drives it sweetly through the covers, beating the two men in the deep to the boundary line.
FOUR! He's going crazy here. Sees the width offered outside off, so the Indian skipper smashes it square through point and sees the ball thud against the ad board.

SIX! That's gone a loooooonnnggg waaayyyy! Straight into the third tier. Gentle loopy ball on the stumps, Rohit Sharma slog sweeps it deep into the mid-wicket stands for half a dozen. What a hit, son!

SIX! 13th T20I fifty for Rohit Sharma! Length delivery on middle and off, Sharma camps back and muscles the pull over mid-wicket for a maximum. Brings up his fifty for that and that's another captain's knock too! He's going to want to make this big now.
Works it away to the mid-wicket area for a single.
Flatter delivery around off, kept out gently off the back foot.
Asela Gunaratne comes on to bowl.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
SIX! Shot, KL! Shot! Wears his dancing shoes to get to the pitch of this delivery, lofts it cleanly and clears the fence straight over the bowler's head.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Darted on middle and leg, forced to long on for a single.

FOUR! This is poor, should be doing much better given the runs are anyway flowing for the Indians. Sharma cuts this towards point, the fielder there dives to his left but can't stop it. It wasn't too far away from him so he should have the batsmen down to maximum a single. Instead, it goes past Thisara Perera too at short third man who can't stop it. Boundary results. With the hit, this is now India's highest opening stand against Sri Lanka in T20Is.

FOUR! He, too, is welcomed with a boundary! Rohit Sharma looking his aggressive best here. Tossed up from around the wicket outside off, Rohit smacks it over extra cover and finds the boundary with ease.
Chaturanga de Silva will have a go with the ball.
The groundsmen are out now to take care of the dew. A lot of it already out there, expect more of it as the evening progresses.
FOUR! Full ball, Rahul says thank you and puts it away. Just an extension of the arms as he lofts it over wide mid off and sends it across the rope on one bounce.
Fullish in length on the stumps, driven through mid on for one.
FOUR! Shot. Excellent placement. Sees nobody's out there, so picks his spot. Wide outside off, the Indian skipper cuts it hard through cover-point for a boundary.
Another full ball outside off, another single through the covers.
Full and outside off, Sharma with a drive through the covers takes a single. Kusal Perera out in the mops that up.
Bit fuller and slower on middle and leg, KL comfortably pushes it into the vacant mid-wicket area for a brisk single.
Thisara Perera returns to the attack.
Turns it to mid-wicket with his wrists and picks up a single. India end the Powerplay at 59/0. Good recovery from the home side after a relatively slow start in the first couple of overs.
Nicely done. Comes down the track and eases it to long on to get off strike.

SIX! Another miscued hit from Rohit Sharma, and another maximum. The boundaries are short here at the Holkar Stadium so expect a lot of these this evening. Fuller outside off, Sharma swings and clears extra cover. While doing that, clears the rope as well with ease.
FOUR! Full, flat and a fraction straight in line, Rohit takes advantage of it and sweeps it through fine leg for a boundary.
Quite full outside off, pushed a little square on the off side.
FOUR! Welcomes him with a boundary! Rohit uses his feet to Akila and takes it on the full. Pierces the gap in the mid-wicket region and sends it across the boundary line, beating the man in the deep.
Akila Dananjaya to roll his arm over.
Outside off, good length delivery, pushed towards point. No run taken on this occasion.
SIX! Downtown! Played an excellent straight drive earlier, did something similar now but took the aerial route. Lofted this over the long on fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Poor line, all Rahul has to do is help it on its way. Picks it off his pads and works it fine down the leg side, beating short fine leg for a boundary.

Takes the pace off and deceives Rohit. Nicely done. The Indian skipper is early into the shot as he looks to paddle it on the leg side. It goes off the leading edge and flies over the vacant slip cordon for a single.
Touch ahead of a length, pushed into the covers but straight to the fielder.

SIX! He didn't time that shot well but it's gone all the way! Back of a length delivery on off, Rohit Sharma stands tall and pummels it in his favourite area. Pulls it over mid-wicket and gets a maximum to his name.
Nuwan Pradeep is into the attack now.
Length delivery outside off, KL looks to put bat on ball but fails to do so. End of the over.
Attacks the stumps this time, Rahul makes room and gives the charge to whack it again, but then gets it off the inner half down the track for nothing.

SIX! What a shot! Wow. KL Rahul with an absolute bomb of a shot. Brute force, this. Stands firm to this length ball outside off and hammers it over long off. In the upper tier so that's a massive biggie. Unbelievable hit that from KL Rahul, most wouldn't be able to even dream of hitting it like that.
Back of a length outside off, guides to slip very late. Wants to take a risky run but then comes to his senses and goes back inside his crease.
Uses the depth of his crease well, waits for the ball to come to him and pushes it into the off side.
Clears the infield and clears it with ease. That's all he needed to do with the fielders inside due to the Powerplay. Shorter around off, Rahul lofts it over mid on. Picks up two runs for doing so.
The batsman has played it to the point region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short outside off, punched off the back foot in sweeper cover's direction for a run.
Just ahead of a length outside off, driven firmly towards cover where the fielder makes a dive to his left to make a half-stop. Single taken.
Skidding close to off on a good length, KL looks to put bat on ball but gets an inside edge on that which falls beside him safely.

Dropped! That was a dolly. Should have... Should have taken it. In and out straight! Short and wide, Rahul flays it straight to Sadeera Samarawickrama at backward point. He gets low, but the ball pops right out of his hands. Poor, that. Could very well pay for that mistake, Sri Lanka.
Fuller on off, blocked towards mid-wicket with a closed face.
Some zip, on middle and off, played off the inner half wide of mid on for a quick run.

FOUR! Good ball, but that's a seriously good shot. Bit fullish on middle and off, Rahul with a perfectly straight blade punches this straight back down. No point in mid off going after that, he's never going to catch up with it.
Rohit goes in the same area. Plays this late, waits for it and then chops it behind point. Third man comes to his left as the batsmen cross over.
Shaping away just a shade as it lands outside off, on a good length, KL opens the face of the bat before running it down to third man for a single. Off the mark with that.
Length ball in the channel outside off, a rather mistimed punch from KL Rahul which finds the man at mid off.
Tight line. Good first delivery as it's landed on a length on off, skids off the surface a bit as Rahul stays back to defend it on the leg side.
Dushmantha Chameera will bowl from the other end.
Dot ball to end the over. But good first over for India, 8 off it. This length ball outside off is run down to short third man.
FOUR! Rubbish ball! Short, with no pace at all, gives ample time to Rohit Sharma to go back and pull it over wide mid on. Clears the infield with ease and sends it all the way for a boundary.
Short and outside off, run down to third man with an open face. Both batsmen want the single but then abort it.
FOUR! That's gone in a flash! A little room outside off, can free his arms so Rohit Sharma flays it over backward point. A couple of bounces and it's away for a boundary.
Touch fuller in length, skidding a bit off the surface, Rohit plays it off the outer half towards short third man.
Starts off with a length delivery on off stump, Rohit hangs back and plays it back down the track to the bowler.

Time to play the game! The Indian openers, KL Rahul and Rohit Sharma stride out to open the innings. The stadium is echoing with the chants of Rohit! Rohit! Rohit! The skipper has become a real star now and is loved by one and all. He will face the first ball. It will be Angelo Mathews (who has dismissed Rohit 10 times across all formats) to kickoff proceedings. A slip in place and the keeper is standing up to the stumps. Here we go...

Time for national anthems. The players from both sides are out in the middle to sing their respective anthems. An excellent crowd has come to watch this contest, in spite of this series being a one-sided affair. They want to watch the home team's dominance, don't they?

Rohit Sharma (despite losing the toss) says winning the match is the most important thing. Adds what they do on the field matters the most. Feels the conditions are good to bat on and wants to play the way they did in the first game. Continues saying they have to post a good total first and then bowl well later. Emphasizes that every game is important and they don't want to get complacent at any point. States that they want to finish well and end the series on a high. Ends by informing the team is unchanged.

Thisara Perera says they would like to bowl first. Mentions the boundaries are small so wants to chase. Informs there are two changes - Sadeera Samarawickrama and Chaturanga de Silva are in for Vishwa Fernando and Dasun Shanaka.
Toss - Sri Lanka win the toss and opt to field first!

This Indian unit, even without some regular players are a dominant force. Players coming in have grabbed their opportunities and kept pushing India forward on the winning path. The toss will be coming up shortly, will be an important one for both teams, especially Sri Lanka, given the dew will play its part again. Stay tuned...

Hello and welcome for the 2nd T20I between India and Sri Lanka in Indore. It's make or break time for the Lankans. Their tour to India can be labelled as poor on the whole. They've performed poorly and the results reflect exactly that. This game becomes all the more important keeping all that in mind. They want this win, they need this win and they must give their all for this win. But it won't be an easy task by any means.
